$comment: English texts of data/fame.json (src/engine/overlay.js): the Fame Points of the characters, their sources for the list “What earns Fame”, and the words of the Fame tab.

wanted.label: Wanted poster reward from the headman

work.label: Work in the Professions, for every {minutes} minutes

avatar.label: System Avatar's work, for every {minutes} minutes

upgrade.label: Successful upgrade on the Anvil, up to +{to}

upgrade-high.label: Successful upgrade on the Anvil, from +{from}

texts.lead: You earn Fame Points for ordinary things you can do again and again. They count from Monday midnight to the end of Sunday.
how: When the week closes, the three best characters of three different players share {pool} by the points they earned. Only the best character of an account gets a reward.
The best character of the week has a gold name for the whole next week, wherever names show.
You take the reward here with “Claim”. It waits until you take it.
With equal points, the older character stands higher.
Guild Fame is something else: the whole guild earns it, and it shows in the Ranking, on the Guilds tab.
notes: Explorations and work in the Professions count when you claim the report. An exploration that ends in defeat gives nothing.
The Towers and new Portal stages give no Fame Points: only things you can repeat count.
texts.left: Until the end of the week: {time}
texts.lastNone: Nobody earned Fame Points last week.
texts.empty: Nobody has earned Fame Points this week yet.
texts.champion: Best character of the previous week in Fame
texts.nothing: You have no Fame reward to claim.
texts.raced: The reward changed in the meantime. Try again.
